refero:593.summary: In Manage library → Templates (empty), the user names a new template, chooses Build a branded template, sets colors/fonts with live previews, edits the template canvas under a draft banner, confirms Publish vs Keep draft, then sees Draft cards back in the library.
steps: New template modal — name + two paths
Template editor — You are editing a template
Publish this template? Keep draft / Publish
steal: Empty state value prop + dual CTA (+ New template header and center) before any templates exist (step 1).
Name-first modal with Build branded vs Customize from gallery (steps 2–3).
Live slide-type previews (chart / sample / text) while setting brand colors and Upload font (steps 4–7).
Persistent 'You are editing a template' banner + Publish this template? Keep draft vs Publish for workspace members (steps 8–9); Draft badge on library cards (step 10).
avoid: Full presentation style-builder depth (fonts, chart styles, slide chrome) as the path to a scenario template — clashes with deliberately basic SCE editor (no Maestro-style surface).
refero:593.fit: Strong crud pattern for org-library scenarios: blank vs gallery, draft/published, share-on-publish; extend today's SCE without becoming a branded slide product.

mobbin:f0c62f24-6d13-42f6-acb6-f36d7c2a8.summary: On a selected slide the user opens the Speaker notes side panel, types notes tied to that slide, then closes the panel (notes icon retains a presence indicator).
steps: Panel closed — notes icon with dot
steal: Per-slide notes in a side panel while the canvas stays visible (steps 2–3).
Placeholder Add speaker notes… until content exists (step 2).
Notes icon badge/dot after close so presence is visible without keeping the panel open (step 4).
mobbin:f0c62f24-6d13-42f6-acb6-f36d7c2a8.fit: Lightweight scripts/cue pattern for SP or faculty notes per scenario phase — extends Briefing without a branching Maestro editor; presenter-only notes map to role-specific cue cards.
